final_message:
I cleaned the data by removing 7 duplicate rows. I normalized the region names by stripping spaces and capitalizing them. I excluded orders with missing amounts (-999) from revenue calculations and counted 8 distinct orders with missing amounts. I parsed the dates in mixed formats and timezones to filter orders in the North region placed in Q1 2024. I then calculated the sum of amounts and counted distinct orders for that period. I also found the region with the highest total amount over the whole file.

The results are saved in workspace/answer.json.
